cases.upstream: signal is an abort signal, not an arbitrary value
cases.notes: Passing a String for signal is rejected by the analyzer.

cases.upstream: keys per-tool options by inferred tool names
cases.notes: Dart exposes toolOptions as Map<String, WebMcpToolOptions>. Neither Map nor List<ClientTool> can statically infer a key union from the tool list.
cases.runtime_alternative: registerWebMCPTools looks up toolOptions[tool.name]. There is no validation that toolOptions keys belong to the tool list; unknown keys are silently ignored.

cases.notes: The Map<String, WebMcpToolOptions> value type is enforced by the analyzer.

cases.upstream: unknown tool option keys are rejected
cases.notes: A Dart Map<String, WebMcpToolOptions> accepts any String key. The analyzer cannot reject unknown_tool, so this case is intentionally not faked.
cases.runtime_alternative: No existing runtime validation. registerWebMCPTools reads only keys matching tool.name; unknown keys do not fail registration.

cases.upstream: annotations are WebMCPToolAnnotations with boolean hints
cases.notes: readOnlyHint and untrustedContentHint are bool?; a String is rejected.

cases.upstream: tool option and annotation objects expose only documented fields
cases.notes: WebMcpToolOptions accepts title/annotations; WebMcpToolAnnotations accepts readOnlyHint/untrustedContentHint. Unknown named parameters are rejected.

cases.upstream: requires the runtime context inferred from contextual tools
cases.notes: RegisterWebMCPToolsOptions.context is Object?. Dart cannot infer a required context shape from ClientTool.execute or require it at registration.
cases.runtime_alternative: No existing runtime validation. options.context is passed through to ToolCallContext.context when the registered tool executes.

cases.upstream: context must satisfy every contextual tool
cases.notes: With context typed as Object?, any value is accepted statically. A positive fixture shows a tenant map, but mismatch cannot be rejected by the analyzer.
cases.runtime_alternative: No existing validation. The tool execute callback receives the supplied context and may fail when it reads missing fields.

cases.upstream: does not expose cross-origin registration options

cases.notes: registerWebMCPTools expects two positional arguments (tools, options); calling with only tools is rejected.

validated_by_registerWebMCPTools: non-object top-level input schemas are rejected
not_validated: toolOptions keys outside the registered tool list
